rules.rule: Report only defects that must be fixed before merge; no praise, no summaries, no restating the diff.
One terse line per finding: file, line, severity, rule id, and the concrete fix — nothing else.
Treat every hardcoded credential, key, token or connection string in the diff as critical, even in tests or demo code; demand environment configuration. Quote the offending line verbatim.
Treat SQL, shell or path strings assembled from variables as critical injection risk until proven parameterised.
Treat missing authorisation checks, unvalidated redirects and deserialisation of untrusted data as critical.
Every behaviour change in the diff must arrive with a failing-first test; flag any production change unaccompanied by test edits as major.
Flag any untested error path, boundary value or concurrency interaction as major.
Flag functions longer than 40 lines, nesting deeper than 3 levels, and dead code introduced by the diff.
Flag vague names (data, result, handle_stuff), bare except clauses, and mutable default arguments.
Flag any new public function, class or module without a docstring.
